title: 第19章 三绝会顶甲子之约第20章 破体无形忘情太极
lines: 狂士江寒，原来他就是狂士江寒！
江湖上大小两个狂人齐聚，这下有意思了。
围观的武林人士眼中顿时冒出奇异神采。
老神仙张三丰还未登场，他们就预先看到了一场好戏。
江寒稳坐当下，面对天下第一狂人的邀请，并未离座。
“燕前辈那边都是重量级人物，待着压力大，美食珍馐摆在面前，都食之无味了。还是我这边待着舒服自在一些。”
听到这话，在场众人面色齐变。
拒绝，江寒居然拒绝了！
拒绝谁不好，拒绝这位天下第一狂人，难道不知道忤逆的代价吗？
燕狂徒直视江寒，陡然一股莫名的压力席卷席间，径直朝着江寒而去。
同桌的武林人士，已经被这股狂力逼退，整个人倒飞出去。
甚至两桌之间的席位上，江湖人士也都扛不住这股力道，纷纷倒地，被压的喘不上气。
面对燕狂徒的压力，江寒体内的不死印法运转，将这股压力完全转化。
“哈哈，我果然没有看错。刚才我进来的时候，全场所有人，就只有你捕捉到了我的气机。不像那些酒囊饭袋！现在连我的气势也能接下，和我那徒儿和儿子一样，未来可期！”
燕狂徒是极有资格说这话的。
把在场诸位武林人士比作酒囊饭袋，其他人甚至反驳不了。
更因为燕狂徒的儿子是地榜大名鼎鼎的‘君临天下’李沉舟。
他的唯一弟子是同样位列黑榜上的“疯子”关七！
本以为燕狂徒的不吝称赞就此结束，可谁料话锋一转：
“可这不是你忤逆我的理由！”
顿时气机更盛，周身的气场之强爆发出璀璨战意，如浪潮、如漩涡，直接将江寒笼罩。
江寒岿然不动，不死印法全力运转，将这股压力尽数吸收。
手上的动作不紧不慢，依旧拿筷子夹着食物。
一老一少，相隔十几米，以两张餐桌为中心，开始了角力。
燕狂徒见气势上无法压倒江寒，索性直接拍出一掌。
玄天乌金掌！
燕狂徒出手就是拿手武功。
一股黑气陡然冲向江寒，霸道诡谲，周围功力弱的，甚至直接昏死过去。
江寒被燕狂徒的进攻刺激到，面对超绝高手的招式，江寒完全不敢托大。
一身功力自动激发。
一股锐不可当的剑势嗡的显现，斩开了燕狂徒的气势。
“好剑意！以身为剑，化身为剑，这股剑势比之谢晓峰和风清扬也不遑多让！”
燕狂徒本就是剑道高手，一身先天无相神功已经练到绝顶。
陡然见到如此新奇的剑势，不由感到技痒。
放下酒杯，抬手，大拇指尖立刻产生了一股强烈的无形气剑。
江寒感受到强烈威胁，万剑归宗的剑意立刻暴涨。
整个大厅内所有剑客的佩剑，此刻都发出嗡嗡锵锵的震动，仿佛时刻都要从剑鞘内弹出来一样。
在场众人已经被这箭拔弩张的气氛看傻了，尤其是所有人的佩剑都仿佛有了生命，仿佛再等一人的命令，那种感觉当真无法言语。
“老燕，我一来就看到你在欺负晚辈了。”
content_en:
Madman Jiang Han, it turns out he is Madman Jiang Han!
Two madmen, big and small, gathered together in the arena, and now it was interesting.
Strange looks suddenly appeared in the eyes of the martial arts people who were watching.
Before the old god Zhang Sanfeng appeared on the stage, they had seen a good show in advance.
Jiang Han sat firmly and did not leave his seat when faced with the invitation from the world's number one madman.
"Senior Yan's side is full of heavyweights. They are under great pressure and the delicacies are placed in front of them, and they are all boring. It's better for me to stay here and feel more comfortable."
Upon hearing this, the expressions of everyone present changed.
Refuse, Jiang Han actually refused!
It is not good to reject anyone. If you reject this madman, don’t you know the price of disobedience?
Yan Kuangtu looked directly at Jiang Han, and suddenly an inexplicable pressure swept across the table, heading straight towards Jiang Han.
The martial artist at the same table had been forced back by this crazy force and flew backwards.
Even the people in the seats between the two tables could not withstand the force and fell to the ground one after another, unable to breathe due to the pressure.
Faced with the pressure from Yan Kuangtui, the Immortal Seal in Jiang Han's body was able to completely transform this pressure.
"Haha, I saw it right. When I came in just now, of all the people in the room, you were the only one who captured my energy. Unlike those wine sacks and rice bags! Now you can even absorb my energy. Just like my disciple and son, you have a bright future!"
Kuangtu Yan is extremely qualified to say this.
Others could not even refute the comparison of all the martial arts people present to a sack of wine and rice.
What’s more, Yan Kuangtu’s son is Li Chenzhou, the famous ‘Jun Lin Tian Xia’ in the land rankings.
His only disciple is the "madman" Guan Qi, who is also on the black list!
I thought that Kuangzu Yan’s generous praise would end there, but unexpectedly the conversation changed:
"But this is not the reason for you to disobey me!"
Suddenly, his energy became stronger, and the aura around him exploded with bright fighting spirit, like a wave or a whirlpool, directly covering Jiang Han.
Jiang Han remained unmoved, and the Immortal Seal was operating at full strength, absorbing all the pressure.
The movements of his hands were unhurried and slow, still holding the food with chopsticks.
An old man and a young man, more than ten meters apart, started wrestling with two dining tables as the center.
Seeing that his momentum could not overwhelm Jiang Han, Kuangtu Yan simply slapped him with a palm.
Xuantian Wujin Palm!
Yan Kuangtu is good at martial arts.
A burst of black energy suddenly rushed towards Jiang Han, so domineering and treacherous that those around him with weak skills even fainted.
Jiang Han was stimulated by Kuangtu Yan's attack. Faced with the moves of a superb master, Jiang Han did not dare to be too confident.
All skills are automatically activated.
An unstoppable sword force appeared, cutting away Kuangtuo Yan's momentum.
"What a sword-power! With your body as a sword, you transform into a sword. This sword's power is comparable to that of Xie Xiaofeng and Feng Qingyang!"
Kuangtu Yan is a master of swordsmanship, and he has mastered the innate formless magic skill to the extreme.
Suddenly seeing such a novel sword power, I couldn't help but feel itchy.
Putting down the wine glass and raising his hand, a strong invisible sword of energy immediately appeared on the tip of his thumb.
Jiang Han felt a strong threat, and Wan Jian Guizong's sword intent immediately surged.
The swords of all the swordsmen in the entire hall were buzzing and vibrating at this moment, as if they were about to pop out of their scabbards at any moment.
Everyone present was dumbfounded by the tense atmosphere, especially because everyone's swords seemed to have come to life, as if they were waiting for someone else's order. The feeling was beyond words.
"Lao Yan, I saw you bullying the juniors as soon as I came here."
title_en: Chapter 19: The Agreement of the Three Supreme Beings Chapter 20: Tai Chi, Invisible and Forgotten
